text.tspan: Trigger: the mission team submits a controlled EPS design change against a named baseline.
Preconditions: the request identifies the proposed change and target baseline.
Success: affected evidence is updated and a correct review package is issued. An absent
baseline or unresolved inconsistency prevents a successful change outcome.
Submit change request and target baseline
Validate request and target baseline identity
Identify affected requirements, interfaces, assumptions, analyses, and verification
Present impact set and coverage gaps
Authorize change scope and submit revisions
Execute affected analyses and return results
Retain change record and evidence package
